ILYA AXELROD — NEW PROGRAM IN PHOENIX

Ilya Axelrod is coming to Phoenix with a new program.

Smart, precise, and highly relatable humor about the things we all know: love and relationships, family and children, growing older, our fears, our quirks, and those situations in which we recognize ourselves a little too easily.

Ilya knows how to talk about serious things in a light and funny way. His performances are not just a collection of jokes, but a live conversation with the audience — sincere, personal, and filled with that special feeling that everything happening on stage is, in some way, about each of us.

New material, live interaction, and an evening you’ll want to keep talking about long after the program ends.
